title: SigSearchTwin dual search engines
description: The Signature Search Twin is a Signature original: two search personalities in one system — SigDeep for analytics-scale full-text with aggregations, and SigInstant for typo-tolerant instant UX — sharing one document pipeline. The dual-personality architecture is an original Signature design.
